description: Tish Frank, Georgia O'Keeffe, and two unknown women having a picnic lunch at Pickaxe Canyon.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Others Having a Picnic Lunch at Pickaxe Canyon
